identificationModule.briefTitle: Trial of Pancreatic Enzyme Supplements (Pancrelipase) for Treating Pain in Patients With Chronic Pancreatitis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-Center Prospective Randomized Placebo Controlled Trial of Pancreatic Enzyme Supplements (Pancrelipase) for Treating Pain in Patients With Chronic Pancreatitis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study purpose is to characterize the effect of pancreatic enzyme supplementation on chronic pancreatitis type pain.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Study Type: Interventional, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, crossover design, efficacy study Intervention arm: Pancreatic enzyme replacement (Pancrelipase) with meals and snacks daily, for 4 weeks.

Placebo arm: Lactose placebo tablets with meals and snacks, for 4 weeks. Washout Phase: Weeks 4 to 6, there will be cessation of placebo or Pancrelipase use.

Crossover Phase: Weeks 6 to 10, initial placebo arm receives Pancrelipase, Pancrelipase arm receives placebo

Surveys - Izbicki score and PANQOLI assessment occur at Week 0, 4, 6, and 10. Narcotic and non-narcotic usage will also be noted at these intervals. Patient will also report the tobacco and alcohol use.

armGroups.label: Intervention Arm
armGroups.description: Pancreatic enzyme replacement (Pancrelipase) with meals and snacks daily, for 4 weeks.

armGroups.label: Placebo Arm
armGroups.description: Lactose placebo tablets with meals and snacks, for 4 weeks.

interventions.name: Pancrelipase
interventions.description: Oral Pancrelipase, 720,000 units spread throughout the day with meals and snacks, taken daily PO for 4 weeks

interventions.name: placebo
interventions.description: Placebo will consist of lactose, spread throughout the day with meals and snacks, taken daily PO for 4 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change in pain scores based on Izbicki self-assessment score
primaryOutcomes.description: Difference in pain scores based on Izbicki self-assessment will be evaluated to determine if pancrelipase improves pain symptoms in patients with chronic pancreatitis

secondaryOutcomes.description: Difference in quality of live evaluated on PANQOLI assessment
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Pancreatic Quality of Life Instrument (PANQOLI) assessment at weeks 0, 4, 6 and 10

secondaryOutcomes.description: Difference in narcotic and non-narcotic use at 0, 4, 6 and 10 weeks of treatment as measured by morphine equivalents

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of chronic pancreatitis based on chronic pancreatitis-type pain \> 6 months leading to impaired quality of life AND at least 1 of the following (27):
* Confirmed diagnosis of hereditary pancreatitis (PRSS1 gene mutation)
* History of recurrent acute pancreatitis (\>1 documented episode of characteristic abdominal pain associated with diagnostic imaging and/or elevated serum amylase or lipase \> 3 times upper limit of normal).
* Pancreatic calcifications on CT scan
* At least 2 of the following:
* Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) with = or \> 4 criteria for chronic pancreatitis (hyperechoic foci, strands, or ducts, lobulation, irregular duct margin, visible side - branches, calcifications, cysts, ductal dilatation) (28)
* Ductal (changes in side branch morphology) or parenchymal (loss of T1 signal intensity) abnormalities on secretin enhanced Magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP)
* Abnormal endoscopic pancreatic secretory function tests (HCO3 \<= 75mmol/L at 30 or 45 minutes or \<= 80mmol/L at 1 hour
* Subjects are capable of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Lactation
* Active acute pancreatitis or an episode of acute pancreatitis within 2 months of presentation for evaluation
* Pancreatic cancer
